arguments.content:
-- Migration: backfill customer loyalty level from legacy_code.
-- Mapping per codes.csv: A -> gold, B -> silver, C -> bronze.

BEGIN;

-- Add the new loyalty column.
ALTER TABLE customers ADD COLUMN reward_band TEXT;

-- Backfill reward_band from legacy_code using the mapping in codes.csv.
UPDATE customers
SET reward_band = CASE legacy_code
  WHEN 'A' THEN 'gold'
  WHEN 'B' THEN 'silver'
  WHEN 'C' THEN 'bronze'
END
WHERE legacy_code IN ('A', 'B', 'C');

COMMIT;
